Dear Partners,

 

We are writing to inform you again about the actions of Mr. Modibo Karagnara, who has already been the subject of several alerts from us. Recently, Mr. Karagnara produced new false financial statements for his company, SOCIETE KARAGNARA ET FRERES (SOKAF). Furthermore, he attempted to bribe our colleagues in Ivory Coast by sending them these false financial statements, which he himself certified instead of a chartered accountant. According to information communicated by our teams in Ivory Coast, Mr. Karagnara asked for their help to obtain credit insurance coverage, offering financial compensation in return.

We are providing you with the details of the company in question:

SOCIETE KARAGNARA ET FRERES (SOKAF SARL)

RCCM: CIABJ 2015 B 8189

NIF: 1514857R

Address: ADJAME LA POSTE DERRIERE LA FOIRE DE CHINE

Telephone: +225 07 47 200 502

Email: sokaf2018@gmail.com

Email 2: toumbe12@hotmail.com

Manager(s): Mr. MODIBO KARAGNARA

 

Please find attached the false financial statements and our previous alerts for your information and for any measures you deem necessary to take.

Dear Partners,

 

This alert concerns Mr. SOYA BATHILY, a Malian citizen for whom we have already issued several warnings. Mr. SOYA BATHILY is known to own numerous fictitious companies in Congo.

We recently discovered another company linked to Mr. Bathily: SOCIETE DALLAS CITY MARKET SARL. This entity uses the name of another Malian, Mr. NDIAYE, as manager and associate.

 

Here are the company's details:

 

  • Company Name: SOCIETE DALLAS CITY MARKET SARL
  • Address: Avenue Félix TCHICAYA, Marché Central, Pointe-Noire
  • NIF (Tax ID): M24000000637141C
  • Location: POINTE NOIRE, CONGO
  • Phone: +242 06 652 28 28
  • Managers: Mr. NDIAYE / Mr. SOYA BATHILY

 

Inconsistencies Identified

According to the tax ID references, the company was created in 2024. However, Mr. SOYA BATHILY presented us with financial statements for three years: 2024, 2023, and 2022.
